the study of the use of virtual environments in higher education, and the analysis of the implications of the use of these environments in the teaching process, in order to support and improve the quality of teaching and learning.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the virtual environment is a tool to support the learning process in a more dynamic, interactive and efficient way, however, the quality of the learning process in the virtual environment is directly related to the quality of the teaching-learning process in the face-to-face environment, since the teacher must be prepared to use this tool, and the student must be prepared to interact in a virtual environment.

b learning, as a pedagogical strategy in the virtual environment, is a process of learning in which the teacher and student are in the same time and place, but the student has access to the Internet and the teacher does not.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the use of virtual environments for learning is a reality, but it requires a careful and critical analysis of the implications of its use, as well as the development of pedagogical strategies to improve the quality of the educational process.
the use of the Internet as a means of communication and information is a reality in the world, and it is not possible to ignore its importance in the field of education.
